Why does my pipeline warn about AndroidBuild@1?

On 2026-10-15, Azure Pipelines shows a retirement error for AndroidBuild@1, but the run does not fail. On 2027-03-15, pipelines that still use AndroidBuild@1 fail.

Find it in your pipelines

With plain grep, nothing to install:

grep -rniwF 'AndroidBuild@1' --include='*.yml' --include='*.yaml' .

How to migrate

Migrate this step manually to Gradle@4.

The task definition of the replacement is linked under official sources above.

AndroidBuild@1 retirement FAQ

Is AndroidBuild@1 deprecated?

Yes. AndroidBuild@1 is retired on 2026-10-15. Azure Pipelines shows a retirement error, but the run does not fail until removal.

When does AndroidBuild@1 stop working?

AndroidBuild@1 is removed on 2027-03-15. Pipelines that still use it fail after removal.

What should I use instead of AndroidBuild@1?

Replace AndroidBuild@1 with Gradle@4.
